title: Zacchaeus

bsb: Zacchaeus, hurry down, for I must stay at your house today.
kjv: Zaccheus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

bsb: He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!
kjv: That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

bsb: Look, Lord, half of my possessions I give to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.
kjv: Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

bsb: Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham. For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.
kjv: This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham. For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

puzzles.prompt: Zacchaeus was too short to see over the crowd. Can you find him?
puzzles.hint: He climbed up a sycamore tree.
Jesus came looking for people who were far from God.

bsb: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.
kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

puzzles.prompt: Tap Jericho, the city of palm trees near the Jordan River.
puzzles.hint: Jericho is in the Jordan valley, north of the Dead Sea.

bsb: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.
kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

bsb: to seek and to save the lost
kjv: to seek and to save that which was lost

reflect: Jesus called Zacchaeus by name. Meeting Jesus changed his heart, and he made things right.
discuss: Why did people grumble when Jesus went to Zacchaeus' house?
How did Zacchaeus change after Jesus came to his house?
Is there something you need to make right with someone? How could you do it?
prayer: Jesus, thank You for coming to seek and save the lost. Change our hearts like You changed Zacchaeus. Amen.
